note: Four identical channel strips (/CH1/../CH4/, one TL072 each: inverting input preamp on half A, tone stack with Bass/Mid/Treble pots on half B, Volume pot as a rheostat into the summing cap) plus the master section (TL072 IC1: half A sums /CH1/OUT, half B buffers the half-supply vbias). Pots and jacks are front-panel parts seated by intent fixed_poses; each channel's SMD parts (B.Cu) sit in its pot column.

groups.name: ch1
groups.why: /CH1/ channel strip: input jack J1 -> C5/R4 into IC2A (R5||C6 feedback), R6-R8 feed the Mid/Bass/Treble pots RV1-RV3 (C7/C8 across them, R9/R10/R12 back to IC2B-OUT, wipers via C9/R11/C10 to IC2B-IN-, R13+C11 to GND), Volume RV4 as rheostat -> R14 -> C13 onto the sum bus; C12 is IC2's +12V decap

groups.name: ch2
groups.why: /CH2/ channel strip, same circuit as ch1 around IC3 (C21 its decap, C22 onto the sum bus)

groups.name: ch3
groups.why: /CH3/ channel strip, same circuit as ch1 around IC4 (C30 its decap, C31 onto the sum bus)

groups.name: ch4
groups.why: /CH4/ channel strip, same circuit as ch1 around IC5 (C39 its decap, C40 onto the sum bus)

groups.name: master
groups.why: the mix bus and bias: IC1A sums /CH1/OUT with R3 feedback and drives the output jack J6 through C4; IC1B buffers the R1/R2 half-supply divider (C1 filter) into vbias (C2 its bulk cap) for all five op-amps; C3 is IC1's +12V decap. The DC power jack J5 (+12V, no conditioning parts) sits with it on the east side; near ch3, the channel next to it
